jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE whole female METAMORPHE HUMAN outfit for a futuristic/cyberpunk roguelike. It belongs to a coherent five-stage very-light to very-heavy armor range. Image 1 is the established MEDIUM outfit and the principal reference for the same woman, short fur mantle, natural-cut moss cloth and warm ivory composites. Image 2 is her very-light outfit and the same face/build. Keep this exact class identity and painterly game-sprite treatment.
Adult strong muscular woman, warm olive skin, same determined feminine face and short tousled dark-brown hair. Compact human head seated naturally close to the shoulders with a SHORT NECK. Nearly frontal slightly elevated game view, upper-left light. Calm balanced stance, feet separated, arms slightly away from body, two empty HUMAN hands with natural fingers. No pose-dependent weapon. Entire figure from hair to boot soles with transparent margins.
Modern DRUID identity: moss/olive technical cloth, dark umber leather and flexible joints, a modest warm tan fur shoulder collar and just two or three broad green leaf-cut cloth panels ending at hip/thigh. A few broad smooth rounded ivory BIOCOMPOSITE shells, never carved medieval wood or metal knight armor. Natural curved shell shapes and soft collar, no giant square shoulder blocks. Broad readable materials, matte understated wear. Preserve the earthy olive/ivory/umber palette. No luminous effects, circuitry, tech ornaments, tiny runes or carved leaf patterns.
The complete outfit includes torso, shoulders, arms/gloves, trousers, legs/boots and its default head protection; all regions progress in coverage. Human RESTING form only, no animal parts, claws, horns, tails, powers or implants. No exposed midriff, pinup anatomy, long robe, medieval cape, antler crown or skull. No conventional military infantry or cargo uniform, no robotic chassis, no copper brawler armor.
Designed to remain readable at 56px high inside a 64x64 tile. Large quiet masses, sparse seams, 2-3 broad values per material. Fur is a single chunky mass, not individual hairs. No microtextures, scattered dots, rivet grids or narrow overlapping scales. Same normal human height at every stage; increase protective volume and coverage, NOT the size of the head. Head protection stays compact, hair and face remain recognizable. No broad plate across forehead.
Genuine transparent RGBA background; no halo, floor, cast shadow, scenery, text, board, weapon, shield, staff, spell, aura or extra object. ONE full isolated character only.
STAGE 02 / LIGHT, clearly lighter than Image 1. A fitted short-sleeved olive technical vest, a SMALL ivory sternum insert (not a full breastplate), one curved forearm protector and one leather wrist wrap, fingerless gloves. Elbows/part of upper arms exposed. Small light olive thigh panels, modest knee caps, fitted cloth shins and light reinforced ankle boots. A thin modest tan fur collar and two short green shoulder flaps establish the druid identity with little bulk, nothing resembling a thick full mantle. Dark flexible joints clearly visible. HEAD: same short hair with a very thin dark-brown cloth forehead band mostly hidden by the fringe. No rigid head shell, forehead plate, antlers, crown or helmet. Protective silhouette about 28-30 native pixels wide.
